All the Black Friday deals are live, including Nintendo’s sale. That means you can pick up a whole bunch of new Switch 2 games on the cheap, though you may need extra storage for some of the more space-hungry titles. Luckily, Samsung discounted MicroSD Express cards for the Switch 2, and so has SanDisk.

A 256GB SanDisk MicroSD Express card is down to $49.99, or if you need serious room, a 1TB model has dropped to $289.99 from its usual $359.99. There’s also a 512GB SanDisk card under $100 right now. These are some of IGN’s favorite cards to slot into the Switch 2, thanks to their reliability and speed, making them a worthwhile investment

Save on SanDisk MicroSD Express Cards for Switch 2

While the Switch 2 offers much more storage than the original Switch, its 256GB can still fill up fast. Unfortunately, the Switch 2 doesn't support non-Express MicroSD cards, so you’ll need to splurge on an upgrade if you're just getting into Nintendo's latest console. With read speeds of 880MB/s and write speeds up to 650MB/s or more, these SanDisk Cards are slightly faster than competing options from PNY and Samsung.

How much space you need depends on the games you want to keep accessible at all times, especially as more titles go digital or come as game-key cards. I mean, Final Fantasy 14 alone will eat up close to half the console’s built-in storage. Other titles, like Split Fiction, Kingdom Hearts Collection, and Cyberpunk 2077, also eat up a good chunk of space. For libraries with a lot of titles like those, 1TB might be the way to go. If you tend to go for smaller indie titles or Nintendo's own typically smaller games, you can likely get by with 256GB or 512GB.

See More Switch 2 MicroSD Express Card Deals

You can also save on Samsung MicroSD Express cards and Walmart’s in-house brand, Onn, for Black Friday.

Still Need a Switch 2?

Haven’t gotten Nintendo’s latest console just yet? Well, after the price hike in September, the best Switch 2 deal at the moment is $50 off the Nintendo Switch 2 console bundle that includes Mario Kart World and 3 months of the Nintendo Switch Online membership.
